"### Chart Description: Final Fanchart (pct of GDP)

This chart illustrates the historical and projected debt-to-GDP ratio from 2019 to 2029.

**Layout and Axis:**
*   **Title:** Final Fanchart (pct of GDP)
*   **X-axis (Time):** 2019 to 2029 in two-year increments.
*   **Y-axis (Percentage):** Ranges from 0 to 180. Note: The labels above 80 (00, 20, 40, 60, 80) represent 100%, 120%, 140%, 160%, and 180% respectively.

**Legend and Data Series:**
*   **Actual (Solid Red/Pink Line):** Shows historical data up to 2023, peaking at approximately 158% of GDP. From 2024 onwards, the solid pink line represents the projected path.
*   **Baseline (Dashed Red Line):** The projected baseline starting after the 2023 peak.
*   **Fanchart Shaded Areas:** Represent probability distributions for the projections:
    *   **5-25 pct:** Lightest gray (bottom band)
    *   **25-50 pct:** Medium-light gray
    *   **50-75 pct:** Medium-dark gray
    *   **75-95 pct:** Darkest gray (top band)

**Key Data Points (Approximate):**

| Year | Actual / Projection (Solid Line) | Baseline (Dashed Line) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 2019 | 90% | N/A |
| 2020 | 105% | N/A |
| 2021 | 80% | N/A |
| 2022 | 85% | N/A |
| 2023 | 158% (Peak) | 158% |
| 2024 | 82% | 90% |
| 2025 | 86% | 78% |
| 2027 | 65% | 62% |
| 2029 | 52% | 48% |

**Projected Ranges for 2029:**
By 2029, the uncertainty width (fanchart) expands significantly:
*   **Upper Bound (95th percentile):** ~158% of GDP
*   **Lower Bound (5th percentile):** ~35% of GDP
*   The baseline and actual projections both trend downward toward approximately 50% of GDP by 2029."
